dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 403 IH: To repeal a restriction on the use of funds by the Securities and Exchange Commission to ensure shareholders of corporations have knowledge of corporate political activity.
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Levin of Michigan (for himself, Mr. Case, Mr. Deutch, Mr. Gallego, Mrs. Hayes, Mr. Kim of New Jersey, Mr. Lieu, Mr. McGovern, Ms. Norton, Mr. Sarbanes, Ms. Scanlon, Ms. Schakowsky, Ms. Spanberger, Mr. Suozzi, Mr. Tonko, Mr. Trone, and Ms. Velázquez) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To repeal a restriction on the use of funds by the Securities and Exchange Commission to ensure shareholders of corporations have knowledge of corporate political activity.

section.text: Section 631 of the Financial Services and General Government Appropriations Act, 2021 (division E of Public Law 116–260) is hereby repealed.
